claims.claim: OpenAI Files API allows individual files up to 512 MB, with total organization storage up to 1 TB
OpenAI Files API supports purpose types: assistants, batch, fine-tune, vision, user_data, evals, assistants_output, batch_output, fine-tune-results
Files with purpose=batch expire after 30 days by default; all other files persist until manually deleted
OpenAI Uploads API supports large files up to 8 GB total, with parts uploaded incrementally
OpenAI Fine-tuning API only supports .jsonl files; Batch API supports .jsonl up to 200 MB
Anthropic Files API requires beta header: anthropic-beta: files-api-2025-04-14
Anthropic announced Files API, code execution tool, MCP connector, and extended prompt caching on May 22, 2025
Anthropic Files API maximum file size is 500 MB per file with 100 GB total storage per organization
Anthropic Files API is not supported on Amazon Bedrock or Google Vertex AI
Claude supports images in all Claude 3+ models, PDFs in Claude 3.5+ models, and code execution file types in Claude Haiku 4.5 and Claude 3.7+ models
Files uploaded to Anthropic can only be downloaded if created by skills or code execution tool; user uploads cannot be downloaded
Gemini Files API stores up to 20 GB per project with per-file maximum of 2 GB
claims.notes: Recent updates may have increased to 50 GB project storage and 5 GB per file

claims.claim: Gemini Files are stored for 48 hours and automatically deleted
Gemini Files API is available at no cost in all regions where Gemini API is available
Gemini inline uploads have 20 MB limit vs 2 GB with Files API
W3C File API defines File, Blob, and FileReader interfaces for web browser file handling
FileReader provides three async read methods: readAsArrayBuffer, readAsText, readAsDataURL
FileReader browser compatibility score is 97/100, with full support in modern browsers
Blob interface name originated from Google Gears and represents immutable raw binary data
File System Access API allows reading and writing to local files with explicit user permission
Chrome 122+ supports persistent file permissions without repeated prompts
File System Access API is only supported in Chromium-based browsers; Safari and Firefox do not support it
OpenAI Vector Store and file_search tool implement RAG with automatic chunking, embedding, and retrieval
OpenAI file_search runs both keyword and semantic searches across assistant and thread vector stores
Maximum 128 tools per OpenAI assistant, including code_interpreter, file_search, and function types
Anthropic earns 40% of enterprise LLM spend (up from 12% in 2023); OpenAI fell from 50% to 27%; Google increased from 7% to 21%
claims.notes: Market data from industry analysis, may vary by source

claims.claim: Anthropic Prompt Caching reduces input costs by 90% for cached tokens
Claude Opus pricing is approximately $15 input / $75 output per million tokens; Sonnet is $3 input / $15 output
claims.notes: Pricing may change; verify with official sources

claims.claim: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) allows LLMs to reference external knowledge bases without retraining
